refuse_gt1_end_note.sng.reason: pattern 0 row 0: note byte $FF is not a GoatTracker 1 note

refuse_gt1_pattern_length.sng.reason: pattern 0 is 5 bytes long, not a whole number of 3-byte rows

refuse_gt1_trailing_bytes.sng.reason: 7 bytes follow the last pattern; a GoatTracker 1 song ends there or after a 256-byte filter table

refuse_long_pattern.sng.reason: pattern 0 has 129 rows; a pattern has at most 128

refuse_no_pattern.sng.reason: subtune 0 channel 1's orderlist plays no pattern

refuse_no_pattern_end.sng.reason: pattern 0 does not end with the pattern-end row

refuse_no_subtunes.sng.reason: it declares 0 subtunes; a song has 1-32

refuse_not_gt.sng.reason: it is not a GoatTracker song (no GTS5 or GTS! identification string)

refuse_pattern_missing.sng.reason: subtune 0 channel 2's orderlist plays pattern 3, but the song has 1

refuse_restart_past_end.sng.reason: subtune 0 channel 1's orderlist restarts at byte 2, past its end

refuse_truncated_header.sng.reason: the file ends inside the song header
